title: Vice President, Digital Transformation
description:
**HNI Corporation** is a global family of brands for the workplace and home dedicated to enhancing the spaces where we live, work, and gather. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment where we make a positive impact on others; upholding our beliefs in integrity, inclusion and belonging.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Vice President, Digital Transformation is responsible for leading HNI's digital transformation strategy across the inspiration to order customer journey. The leader will drive the adoption of technology, artificial intelligence, automation, and modern business processes to accelerate growth, improve productivity, and enhance dealer and customer experiences.


This executive partners closely with business leaders across HNI's operating companies to identify, prioritize, and deliver transformational initiatives that create measurable business value with critical focus on the Sales, Digital Marketing, Brand Marketing, and Customer Support areas. The role serves as a key member of the IT leadership team, shaping the future of digital capabilities at HNI.


The Vice President, Digital Transformation is accountable for digital strategy, transformation governance, customer engagement platforms, digital product management, and enterprise change leadership. Success in this role requires balancing strategic vision with operational execution while building organizational capabilities that enable HNI to compete and innovate in a rapidly evolving business environment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Digital Strategy \& Transformation Leadership**

* Own and evolve the digital transformation roadmap supporting capabilities from inspiration to order, aligning investment with HNI’s strategic priorities.
* Serve as the executive voice for digital capability across HNI's operating companies, translating business needs into a coherent technology strategy.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to modernize customer and dealer\-facing digital experiences
* Partner with the CIO and IT leadership team to align digital technology strategy with broader enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Partner with operating company presidents and functional leaders to identify opportunities to improve growth, productivity, customer experience, and business performance.

**Digital Products and Customer Engagement Leadership**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of digital products including corporate and brand website platforms.
* Drive continuous improvement of the digital customer journey, from inspiration and product discovery through order and post\-sales support.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for digital product performance, conversion, uptime, and digital revenue contribution.
* Evaluate and select platform partners, vendors, and tools in partnership with procurement and security.

**Salesforce \& Commercial Technology Leadership**

* Own the enterprise Salesforce platform strategy, roadmap, governance, and platform architecture.
* Ensure Salesforce and related commercial technologies effectively support Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support processes across operating companies.
* Drive platform modernization, integration, and scalability.
* Partner with business stakeholders to prioritize investments and maximize business value from commercial technologies.
* Establish data governance, data quality, security, and change management standards for the commercial technology ecosystem.

**Generative AI \& Emerging Technology**

* Support and substantially contribute to HNI’s generative AI strategy, identifying high\-value use cases.
* Build organizational capability to responsibly pilot, scale, and govern generative AI tools and applications.
* Stay current on emerging digital and AI technologies, assessing their relevance and business case for HNI.
* Partner with executive, legal, security, and data governance functions to ensure responsible and compliant AI deployment.

**Change Leadership \& Organizational Effectiveness**

* Lead enterprise adoption and change management efforts supporting digital transformation initiatives.
* Build executive alignment and stakeholder engagement across functions and operating companies.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure teams are equipped to effectively adopt and maximize new technologies and business processes.

**Team Leadership \& Talent Development**

* Lead and develop a high\-performing organization consisting of digital business partners, program managers, software developers, architects, and business analysts.
* Establish clear goals, accountability and performance expectations aligned with business objectives.
* Build organizational structure, career pathing, and capability plans that scale with business demand.
* Manage budgets, staffing, and vendor/contractor relationships.

**Project \& Business Analysis Governance**

* Establish standardized project management practices, intake processes, and prioritization frameworks across the digital portfolio.
* Ensure business analysis practices produce clear requirements, sound solution design, and measurable business outcomes.
* Report portfolio status, risks, and value delivered to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 15\+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including 10\+ years focused on digital transformation, customer engagement or CRM platforms.
* Demonstrated experience owning an enterprise Salesforce platform at scale.
* Experience leading distributed teams of developers, project managers, and business analysts.
* Direct experience piloting or scaling generative AI capabilities in an enterprise setting strongly preferred.
* Experience in a manufacturing, B2B, or multi\-brand/multi\-business\-unit environment is a plus.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Strategic vision paired with the ability to execute in a fast\-moving, matrixed organization.
* Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills across business and technology leadership.
* Proven change management and organizational design capability.
* Sound business acumen with the ability to connect technology investment to measurable business outcomes.
* Innovation mindset with a pragmatic approach to emerging technology adoption.

**WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU!**

title: Director of Product, Risk & Response
description:
#### **About us**



Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.


Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

#### **About the role**



This is a new role leading a new grouping of three areas that together form Coalition's risk lifecycle: Underwriting (how we select and price risk), Claims (how we close the loop and mitigate losses when something goes wrong), and Security (the Control and Wirespeed products that help policyholders reduce risk in the first place). Each of these has historically been run as its own domain. Your job is to be strategic about how these areas come closer together, recognizing that risk selection, loss mitigation, security telemetry, and claims outcomes are not separate problems but one continuous feedback loop.



This is a people\-leadership role. You will manage a team of product managers across all three areas, help to steer the strategy that connects them, and be accountable for how the combined areas perform. You'll report into product leadership and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, Finance, Operations, and more.



Most of the value in Active Insurance comes from the connections between these functions, not the functions themselves. Security signals from Control and Wirespeed should sharpen how we underwrite. How a claim develops should feed back into how we price risk. The quality of underwriting should shape our loss exposure and therefore our claims load. Today these loops exist, but they aren't owned by anyone as a whole.


**This role is deliberately the one seat that spans them**. It is not a preview of how the rest of the company is organized, and we want to be explicit about that. Engineering leadership for each of these areas reports through the CTO in separate lines. Underwriting, Claims, and Security operate as genuinely different businesses with different economics, different stakeholders, and different rhythms, and we are not trying to merge them. What we are doing is deliberately creating a single product seat that sits across all three, because the connective work is real and currently unowned, and because product is the function best positioned to do it. That means the primary instrument of this role is influence, clarity, and a credible point of view rather than formal authority over the full stack. If that sounds like the interesting part of the job rather than the frustrating part, we should talk.


**Why Security sits in a risk group**. Control is our attack surface monitoring and login security product: we continuously monitor policyholders' external attack surface, watch their Google and Microsoft environments, and lock down accounts that look compromised. It's provided free to all 100,000\+ policyholders, and it exists because reducing their exposure directly reduces our loss ratio. That makes it a risk lifecycle product, not a side business, and it is why it belongs alongside underwriting and claims. Wirespeed MDR is a different motion: a paid, growing revenue line sold both into our policyholder base and to companies who don't buy insurance from us at all. Both matter, and part of the judgment this role requires is holding those two very different mandates at the same time without letting either starve the other.


#### **What You'll Own**


* **Underwriting**. The internal risk decisioning stack: underwriting models and the real\-time systems that execute them, the underwriter workbench and tooling, automation and risk selection, scanning and data collection, and insurance product development. Actuarial builds the pricing models; this organization is accountable for the systems that put them into production correctly, ensuring the right customer data reaches the right model at the right moment, that changes are testable and auditable, and that pricing behaves in production the way it was designed to. This portfolio is about the quality, consistency, speed, and auditability of underwriting decisions through better software and model\-driven workflows.
* **Claims**. The claims operations engine: intake, adjudication, and enablement systems, workflow tools, automation, platform migrations, and ML\-assisted insights. The center of gravity is operational excellence and reducing manual overhead so claims professionals can focus on judgment, empathy, and resolution strategy, while claims data feeds back into how we understand risk.
* **Security (Control \& Wirespeed)**. Control as the connective layer between security telemetry, the policyholder experience, and underwriting workflows, including its growing role as an underwriting\-facing platform (underwriting integrations, outbound ticketing, large\-market and multi\-tenant support). And Wirespeed's MDR/ADR capabilities, integrations, reporting, and competitiveness in a crowded market. The two remain distinct products with distinct goals: Control's job is adoption and measurable risk reduction across the insured base; Wirespeed's job is to win on product merit against dedicated MDR competitors.

#### **What You'll Do**


* Ensure that our product strategy across underwriting, claims, and security is consistent and treats them as one risk lifecycle, and make the deliberate trade\-offs about where to invest across the three.
* Build and develop the product team beneath you, including hiring, coaching, and holding a group of PMs to a high standard across three distinct domains, each with its own stakeholders and technical depth.
* Own the feedback loops between areas: ensure security telemetry informs underwriting, claims development informs pricing, and underwriting quality is measured against realized loss outcomes.
* Own the product surface that makes security adoption possible and scalable: the in\-product activation, onboarding, and value\-demonstration motions that drive policyholders into Control, and the product\-led growth capabilities that convert engaged Control users into paid Wirespeed customers. The commercial motion spans GTM and the broker channel, and you'll partner closely with both, but the product mechanics that make the funnel work are in your domain.
* Partner with Data and Engineering to advance model\-driven workflows, automated decisioning, and ML\-assisted tooling responsibly while managing the operational and regulatory considerations that come with automated decisions in a regulated product.
* Drive major platform evolution and systems migrations across the portfolio, in close partnership with your engineering counterparts.
* Define success metrics that span the portfolio, not just each area in isolation, and use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and make trade\-offs.
* Represent these areas to executive leadership, brokers, and cross\-functional partners, translating between deep technical work and business outcomes.
* Use AI consistently in how you and your team work, and champion an AI\-enabled approach to underwriting, claims, and security products.

#### **Skills and Qualifications**


* 10\+ years in product, with several years leading and developing product managers
* A track record of owning a multi\-domain or platform portfolio and setting strategy across areas that can have competing priorities, finding the connective tissue and making trade\-offs across it.
* Demonstrated ability to lead in technically deep, model\-driven, or data\-heavy product areas, and to partner effectively with Data and Engineering on automation and decisioning.
* Strong people leadership: you hire well, coach deliberately, set clear expectations, and make hard calls on performance without delay.
* Proven experience with major platform migrations or systems transformations of critical internal or enterprise systems.
* Exceptional communication and influence skills, with a track record of driving alignment across diverse senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a build mindset. This is a role for someone who wants to define how these areas operate together, not maintain a settled structure.
* Daily fluency with AI tools as part of product work, and a point of view on how AI reshapes underwriting, claims, and security over time.

#### **Bonus Points**


* Experience with the business of insurance or other regulated financial products due to the underwriting, pricing, claims, policy administration, and compliance\-heavy workflows.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity products, MDR/EDR, security operations, or incident response.
* Prior work shipping products built on predictive models, risk scores, or automated decisioning while managing operational and regulatory constraints.

#### **Compensation**



Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $200,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $260,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job\-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.


#### **Perks**


* 100% medical, dental and vision coverage
* Flexible PTO policy
* Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
* Mental \& physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!
* Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

#### **Why Coalition?**



Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote\-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition's exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real\-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.



We're always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join \#OurCoalition.



Visit our Newsroom \>


#### **Privacy Notice**



Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.



Our Privacy Policy \>


#### **Safe Hiring Notice**



All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you've been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).


#### **Anti\-Discrimination Notice**



Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.


#### **Accommodations**



Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre\-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@coalitioninc.com. We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction.


**To all recruitment agencies:** Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Manager, Provider Dispute Resolution
description:
**Description**
---------------


At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

  



**A Little About Us**


Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.


At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

  



**A Little About You**


You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

**Position Overview**


The Manager, Provider Dispute Resolution is responsible for leading the operational performance, quality, compliance, workforce strategy, and continuous improvement of Zelis' Federal Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) and related Out of Network Post Pay operations. This role drives operational excellence through data\-driven decision making, AI\-enabled workflow adoption, process optimization, and talent development while ensuring exceptional service delivery for clients, providers, and members.
  

  

The Manager partners closely with key stakeholders, such as Product, Technology, Client Management, and other key partners to improve operational performance, influence product and workflow enhancements, and support enterprise initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and customer outcomes. This leader creates an environment of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement while developing high\-performing teams capable of adapting to evolving business and regulatory requirements.**What you do:**

Operational Leadership \& Business Performance

* Lead the day\-to\-day operational execution of Federal IDR and Out of Network Post Pay functions, ensuring achievement of quality, productivity, compliance, financial, and service\-level objectives.
* Develop and execute operational plans that improve business performance, customer experience, operational efficiency, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish, monitor, and communicate operational KPIs, business metrics, and performance trends while driving accountability for measurable business outcomes.
* Utilize data and operational insights to proactively identify risks, workflow bottlenecks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Balance operational priorities while ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant claim dispute resolution.


Process Improvement, Innovation \& AI

* Champion continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to redesign workflows, simplify processes, and eliminate operational inefficiencies.
* Drive adoption and optimization of AI\-enabled workflows, automation technologies, and operational tools that improve productivity, quality, scalability, and associate effectiveness.
* Partner with Product teams to translate operational challenges into system enhancements, automation opportunities, and future product capabilities.
* Support implementation of new operational processes, technologies, and business initiatives while ensuring successful organizational adoption.


Workforce, Inventory \& Resource Management

* Develop inventory management strategies utilizing forecasting, workload balancing, capacity planning, and workforce optimization techniques.
* Manage staffing levels, resource allocation, scheduling, and organizational structure to support changing business volumes and service expectations.
* Monitor inventory health, backlog performance, throughput, and cycle times while implementing corrective actions as necessary.
* Partner with leadership to develop flexible staffing models that support evolving operational demands.


Compliance \& Operational Governance

* Ensure operational compliance with Federal Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR), the No Surprises Act (NSA), client\-specific requirements, and internal operational standards.
* Monitor operational risks, workflow exceptions, audit findings, and regulatory changes while implementing sustainable corrective actions.
* Promote operational consistency through standardized procedures, quality controls, and governance practices.
* Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, regulatory updates, and operational best practices that impact Out of Network Post Pay operations.


Cross\-Functional Leadership

* Build strong partnerships across key stakeholders to align priorities and improve business outcomes.
* Influence operational strategy by providing business insights, performance trends, and recommendations that support enterprise decision\-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to improve workflow design, operational processes, reporting capabilities, and customer experience.
* Present operational performance, forecasts, risks, and improvement recommendations to leadership and business partners.


Leadership \& Team Development

* Build and develop a high\-performing team through coaching, performance management, career development, succession planning, and continuous feedback.
* Foster a culture of accountability, trust, innovation, collaboration, and responsible experimentation aligned with Zelis leadership expectations.
* Lead through change by communicating priorities clearly, building organizational alignment, and helping associates successfully adapt to evolving business needs.
* Establish clear performance expectations while recognizing achievements and proactively addressing performance concerns.
* Promote associate engagement, continuous learning, and professional growth while encouraging adoption of AI\-enabled tools and new ways of working.

**What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related discipline, or equivalent combination of experience.
* 8\+ years of progressive healthcare operations experience in claims, provider dispute resolution, payment integrity, revenue cycle, or related healthcare operations.
* 5\+ years of people leadership experience managing operational teams and business performance.
* Demonstrated success leading operational process improvement initiatives that produced measurable business results.
* Experience managing operational inventories, workforce planning, productivity, quality, and service\-level performance.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage operational data to identify trends, solve complex problems, and drive informed business decisions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams.
* Proven ability to lead through change while balancing operational execution with strategic priorities.

**Preferred skills:**

* Experience supporting Federal Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR), No Surprises Act (NSA), Out of Network claims, Pricing Operations, or Payment Integrity.
* Experience leading automation initiatives, AI\-enabled workflows, digital transformation, or operational technology implementations.
* Experience managing matrixed and/or global teams.
* Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or other continuous improvement certification.
* Experience utilizing business intelligence, operational reporting, and workflow management platforms.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Ability to travel domestically up to 10%.

 ***Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.***

 **Location and Workplace Flexibility**


Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In\-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.

  

While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in\-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.

title: DVP, Logistics, Materials & Global Repair
description:
Overview:
**Who We Are:**

  

Ever wonder who brings the entertainment to your flights? Panasonic Avionics Corporation is \#1 in the industry for delivering inflight products such as movies, games, Wi\-Fi, and now Bluetooth headphone connectivity!

  

How exciting would it be to be a part of the innovation that goes into creating technology that delights millions of people in an industry that’s here to stay! With our company’s history spanning over 40 years, you will have stability, career growth opportunities, and will work with the brightest minds in the industry. If you want to learn more about us, visit us at www.panasonic.aero. And for a full listing of open job opportunities go to https://careers.na.panasonic.com/avionics/jobs.


Responsibilities:
**The Position:**

  

The Division Vice President will lead the global repair and logistics division with accountability for strategy, financial performance, operational execution, digital transformation, and regulatory compliance across worldwide repair, supply chain, logistics, S\&OP, forecasting, materials management, inventory planning, and repair center operations. Oversees end\-to\-end In\-Flight Entertainment Connectivity (IFEC) asset lifecycle support, including planning, procurement, inventory optimization, logistics execution, supply chain development, and global repair center performance. Serves as a key member of the PTS leadership team, translating corporate priorities into multi\-year roadmaps, annual operating plans, and measurable initiatives that drive customer satisfaction, revenue growth, operational excellence, cost efficiency, and scalable business performance. Leads modernization through digital enablement, advanced analytics, AI/ML, predictive maintenance, automation, robotics, business intelligence platforms, and connected operational systems. Improves customer value, material availability, repair performance, supply chain resilience, and digitally enabled aftermarket support across a global operating footprint.

 **EXECUTIVE LEADERSHIP, FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE \& STRATEGY**

* Establish and execute a global multi\-year strategy for supply chain, repair, logistics, and materials management aligned with PTS business objectives and broader corporate priorities
* Translate corporate and functional strategies into multi\-year roadmaps, annual operating plans, financial plans, and measurable key initiatives.
* Serve as a key member of the PTS executive leadership team, contributing to growth strategies, operational planning, customer engagement, and investment decisions.
* Sponsor and govern strategic initiatives, digital enablement, innovation efforts, and continuous improvement programs that improve customer outcomes, cost efficiency, operational resilience, and business performance.
* Develop strategic initiatives that position Panasonic as the industry leader in aviation aftermarket support, repair services, reliability management, and material supply solutions.
* Develop and execute a digital operations roadmap aligned with PAC’s overall enterprise technology strategy including ERP integration with PTS tools and capabilities.
* Lead organizational transformation efforts focused on scalability, innovation, profitability, and operational resilience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Industrial IoT and advanced analytics to improve operational performance.
* Champion the deployment and optimization of ERP, MES, CRM, PLM, quality management systems, and connected data platforms to achieve efficiency and scalability goals.
* Own financial performance with P\&L responsibility for the global materials, logistics, and repair operations portfolio including budget ownership, forecasting, resource allocation, capital planning, and long\-range strategic financial planning.
* Develop annual operating plans, forecasts, capital budgets, and long\-range strategic financial plans.
* Drive EBITDA improvement through productivity gains, inventory optimization, repair efficiencies, automation, and business transformation initiatives.
* Establish operational KPIs, dashboards, and executive reporting frameworks that provide visibility into business performance and S\&OP management.
* Represent the division in executive forums and key stakeholder discussions, presenting business performance, strategic plans, and investment recommendations to executive leadership and board\-level stakeholders.
* Build and develop a high\-performing global leadership team with succession plans and leadership development strategies.
* This position leads multiple directors, senior managers, and geographically distributed teams across North America, EMEA, Asia Pacific, and emerging markets totaling more than 250\+ staff globally.

**GLOBAL MATERIALS, LOGISTICS, WAREHOUSING \& DISTRIBUTION MANAGEMENT**

* Lead the worldwide MRO supply chain organization responsible for inventory planning, procurement, warehousing, logistics, and materials management.
* Ensure effective resource deployment, prioritization, and operating discipline to meet customer, business, fleet, repair, and contractual commitments.
* Develop inventory optimization strategies that maximize service levels while minimizing working capital and inventory risk.
* Establish advanced planning models utilizing AI/ML\-driven demand forecasting, predictive consumption modeling, repair capacity planning, and supply risk analytics to support data\-informed decision\-making.
* Drive adoption of predictive inventory management, predictive maintenance tools, and AI\-assisted repair diagnostics.
* Ensure material availability supports worldwide contractual commitments, fleet operations, repair requirements, and customer service objectives.
* Develop supplier management strategies and logistics network efficiency that improve performance, quality, lead\-times, profit, and cost competitiveness. Drive process optimization, standardization, and global consistency across logistics, warehousing, distribution, supplier processes, material flow, and cross\-functional workflows.
* Drive global trade compliance, customs compliance, export controls, and regulatory requirements across the MRO supply chain network.
* Lead initiatives for obsolescence management, strategic sourcing, long\-term supply assurance, and lifecycle management.
* Lead worldwide logistics and distribution operations supporting airline customers, field service teams, and repair facilities.
* Develop integrated logistics strategies that optimize transportation, warehousing, customs clearance, and material flow.
* Implement digital visibility solutions that provide real\-time tracking of inventory, repairs, shipments, and operational performance.
* Establish contingency plans and supply continuity strategies for geopolitical disruptions, supplier constraints, and transportation risks.

**GLOBAL REPAIR OPERATIONS \& MRO EXCELLENCE**

* Direct all global repair facilities and repair service operations to achieve world\-class quality, turnaround time, cost, and customer satisfaction performance.
* Develop and implement standardized repair methodologies, capacity planning models, and progress global operating procedures.
* Implement advanced repair analytics to identify reliability trends, root causes, cost drivers, and repair opportunities.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Theory of Constraints, and Operational Excellence initiatives across all repair centers.
* Drive adoption of predictive maintenance and condition\-based maintenance methodologies through updated repair hardware, software, data analytics and AI\-enabled technologies.
* Ensure repair facilities maintain compliance with all FAA, EASA, CAA, CAAC, JCAB, and other applicable aviation authority requirements.
* Establish global repair center performance standards, benchmarking, and continuous improvement programs.
* Maximize repair performance while managing inventory levels to achieve an efficient balance of material flow, on\-site storage, and parts availability.

**REGULATORY COMPLIANCE, QUALITY \& SAFETY**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable MRO aviation regulations, quality standards, and company policies.
* Champion compliance with FAA, EASA, CASA, UKCAA, GCAA, AS9110, AS9100, ISO, environmental, trade, and occupational safety requirements.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, customer focus, diversity, collaboration, and employee development.
* Maintain strong oversight of risk management, audit readiness, corrective action governance, regulatory inspections, customer audits, SMS reporting, and certification activities.
* Maintain a strong culture of safety, operational integrity, and regulatory excellence.


The salary range of $228,000 \- $382,000 is just one component of Panasonic’s total package. The final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to individual’s knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses and incentives.


Qualifications:
**What we're looking for:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business Administration, Aviation Management, or related field.
* A combined 12\+ years of progressive leadership experience within aviation, aerospace, MRO, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or technology industries.
* 10\+ years of senior leadership responsibility managing large multi\-site organizations.
* Experience leading global repair operations, supply chain organizations, or complex operational networks.
* Experience managing large operating budgets, capital investment, and P\&L responsibilities.
* Domestic \& international travel is required, likely up to 25%.
* Ability to travel globally to support customers, suppliers, repair centers, and operational facilities.
* Primarily working in the office, ability to support office \& working from global sites.


Preferred

* Master’s Degree (MBA, Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or related discipline).
* Advanced certifications such as: APICS/ASCM, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, Aviation Maintenance Management Certifications.
* Experience with digital aviation ecosystems, predictive maintenance platforms, and connected aircraft technologies.

**Executive Leadership, Strategy \& Execution:**

* Proven executive leadership within a global aviation, aerospace, MRO, supply chain, manufacturing, or technology organization. Demonstrated ability to execute division\-level strategies aligned with enterprise priorities, translating business objectives, market insights, customer needs, and operational requirements into actionable plans that drive measurable business outcomes and operational performance.
* Strong strategic planning and business transformation capabilities.
* Experience managing complex multinational operations.
* Executive presence and stakeholder management.
* Strong executive communication and influencing skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders, translate priorities across diverse global teams, navigate complex business issues, resolve competing priorities, and drive decisions across functions, regions, and stakeholder groups.
* Strong financial and business acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, resource allocation, and P\&L performance management while balancing growth, cost discipline, and operational efficiency.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
* Exceptional communication and presentation capabilities.
* Ability to lead large\-scale organizational change initiatives.
* Demonstrated success building high\-performance global teams.
* Proven ability to coach leaders, support succession planning, build leadership capability, and align talent development strategies to improve divisional performance.

**Deep expertise of Supply Chain \& Repair Operations:**

* Aviation supply chain management including budgeting, forecasting, planning, pricing and estimating.
* MRO operations including understanding of regulatory constraints, documentation control, and management of Hardware in a Part 145 environment.
* Repair center management and measurements of quality, success, profitability, manpower planning, staff management, and employment requirements for global operations.
* Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) including alignment across cross\-functional organizations from Part 21 manufacturing to distribution models for contract fulfillment.
* Material planning and forecasting including S\&OP, integration with factory forecasting, ERP\-system alignment and efficiency of organizational activities.
* Inventory optimization to ensure the highest possible material availability while maximizing profitability, efficiency, and reducing waste.
* Global logistics and distribution for support of Line Maintenance, Repair, Material programs, and transactional sales.
* Supplier management and sourcing to ensure success of contracted services.
* Ability to build strong customer relationships and align internal teams to deliver value through improved material availability, repair performance, service levels, and supply chain efficiency.
* Strong governance, risk, quality, safety, and compliance mindset, ensuring practices align with corporate governance expectations, customer commitments, and applicable regulatory requirements.

**Digital \& Technology:**

* Experience leading enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of AI, Machine Learning, predictive analytics, Business Intelligence, automation, and operational technology platforms.
* Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, RAMCO, or equivalent MRO and enterprise platforms.
* Experience leveraging data analytics to improve operational performance and decision making.

**Our Principles:**
Contribution to Society \| Fairness \& Honesty \| Cooperation \& Team Spirit \| Untiring Effort for Improvement \| Courtesy \& Humility \| Adaptability \| Gratitude
What We Offer:

* Paid time off: Exempt Salaried employees receive flexible paid time off. This means that there is no fixed number, range, or limit to the amount of Personal and Vacation Days that may be taken for exempt employees. title: SENIOR PRICING MANAGER
description:
**Description**


**Senior Pricing Manager**


The Senior Pricing Manager is the organizational owner of Pricing for the brand. This role is responsible for building the pricing strategy from the ground up, defining frameworks, processes, tools, and governance that maximize revenue, margin, competitiveness, and customer value perception across all markets (enterprise, regional, and country\-level).


This is a high‑visibility, high‑impact individual contributor role that combines strategic leadership with tactical execution, requiring someone comfortable designing long\-term pricing strategy while also rolling up their sleeves to implement, maintain, analyze, and iterate pricing decisions in real time.


You will partner closely with Senior Leadership, Merchandising/Product, Finance, Strategy, and Operations to build and maintain a pricing system that is data‑driven, competitive, and aligned with brand, margin, and growth objectives.

**Essential Tasks and Responsibilities:**

**Pricing Strategy \& Ownership (Strategic)**

* Build and own the companywide Pricing strategy across regions
* Develop pricing frameworks and governance models
* Set up value‑based pricing methodologies and competitive benchmarking models
* Lead pricing guardrails, rules, and approval workflows
* Partner with Leadership to identify pricing opportunities that increase revenue, margin, and competitiveness
* Manage and measure customer price perception

**Pricing Process Design \& Systems (Strategic \+ Operational)**

* Lead the design and deployment of AI/automation\-enabled pricing infrastructure to scale decision\-making, reduce cycle time, and eliminate manual workflows
* Implement tools, dashboards, and analytical models
* Own cross\-functional pricing communication

**Analytics, Insights \& Optimization (Hands\-on \+ Strategic)**

* Conduct competitive analyses, market scans, and cost/margin analyses
* Develop and maintain dynamic pricing models incorporating elasticity, competitive signals, and AI\-generated demand forecasts
* Monitor post‑implementation price performance
* Provide insights on customer sensitivity and competitive dynamics

**Execution \& Implementation (Hands\-on)**

* Own governance and approval of price changes across systems; partner with operations to execute with accuracy and speed
* Manage external data vendors
* Resolve operational pricing escalations
* Maintain documentation of pricing workflows


Cross\-functional Leadership (Individual Contributor)

* Serve as the pricing subject\-matter expert
* Partner with Finance, Product/PD, Ops, Marketing, and Digital
* Lead evaluation, selection, and procurement of pricing tools and vendor partnerships; own the pricing tech stack roadmap

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Science, or related field.


7\-10 years of experience in Pricing, Strategy, FP\&A, or Analytics.

* Demonstrated track record of building or rebuilding a pricing function from the ground up required.
* Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI and automation tools (e.g., Python, ML\-based pricing engines, LLM\-assisted analysis) to surface insights, drive pricing decisions, and reduce manual workflows. Experience with BI platforms (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) required; comfort working in data environments without relying on spreadsheet\-first approaches.
* Experience with SAP or similar systems a plus.
* Experience with price optimization software (Pros, Zilliant, or similar) a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable pricing infrastructure, not just ad hoc models.
* Strong P\&L literacy; fluency in gross margin analysis and revenue modeling.
* Proven ability to lead change management and influence cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred (not required).
* Strong balance of strategic and tactical capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills for leadership audiences.

description:
FASHIONPHILE is more than just fashion — we’re revolutionizing the ultra\-luxury fashion experience in order to create a sustainable alternative that extends the life cycle of products and makes them more accessible to a diverse customer base. As we strive to become the world's most sought\-after brand in luxury re\-commerce, we know it's our team members who make it all happen! We value diversity in our people, perspectives, and products. For us, it's the only way to cultivate the creativity and innovation essential to achieving our mission and supporting our customers. We do this both in\-person and through our digital omni\-channel experiences. If you're someone who embraces change, is authentic, and wants to make an impact this is the place for you. **About The Opportunity**
The Experience Optimization Practice Leader is a senior, hands\-on product and experience practitioner and people manager who leads complex improvement work from problem discovery through implementation and measurement. Each Practice Leader has a primary customer journey lane assignment, but lane alignment provides context and accountability rather than exclusive ownership. Practice Leaders and team members work across lanes based on priorities, expertise, development needs, and capacity. Responsibilities include:

* Personally investigate and frame consequential customer and business problems. Combine data, customer feedback, operational insight, frontline observations, system behavior, and technical context to separate symptoms from root causes.
* Designing practical future states connecting customer interactions, business rules, roles, workflows, communications, data, systems, and controls.
* Evaluating process or policy changes, better use of existing platforms, SaaS configuration, vendor capabilities, integrations, automation, AI\-enabled workflows, and custom software.
* Personally lead complex initiatives from discovery through solution selection, delivery, launch, adoption, stabilization, and learning. Manage fit\-for\-purpose plans, sequencing, dependencies, decisions, risks, testing, readiness, and communication.
* Partnering directly with SaaS providers, implementation partners, Technology, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, and platform owners. Translate customer and business problems into functional behavior, data needs, integrations, dependencies, and success criteria. Contribute actively to feasibility and design decisions and recommend build, buy, configure, integrate, or partner approaches.
* Developing evidence\-based recommendations for priorities within a primary lane and translate approved Experience Optimization strategy into executable work.
* Managing, coaching, and developing a small team of individual contributors while remaining deeply engaged in the work. Set outcome\-based expectations, strengthen technical product thinking and problem\-solving, review the quality of analysis and solution design, and provide direct mentorship.

**What We’re Looking For*** Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* 8\+ years of progressively responsible experience leading customer, digital, product, operational, technology\-enabled, or enterprise improvement work
* Significant hands\-on experience diagnosing problems across people, process, policy, data, systems, vendors, and organizational boundaries
* Experience leading complex initiatives from discovery and future\-state design through implementation, adoption, and measurement
* Experience translating customer and business problems into functional behavior, requirements, data needs, integrations, acceptance criteria, and measures
* Experience partnering with SaaS providers and technical teams to configure, integrate, extend, or co\-design solutions
* Experience managing and developing individual contributors while remaining an active practitioner
* Experience working in matrixed teams where people and expertise move across priorities

**What We Offer*** Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* FSA options for Medical, Dependent Care \& Commuter Benefits
* Paid Time off, Paid Sick Time, and Paid Holidays
* 401(k) with generous match program
* Free Life Insurance and AD\&D
* Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* Employee Discount

 **Pay Scale:** FASHIONPHILE reasonably expects the range to be $115K\-$150K \+ Annual Bonus for this position. The company prefers to hire in our Lehi, Utah location, but is open to all payroll states. Offered compensation will vary based on (a) location; (b) individual candidate qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience. This post may be updated as new market data becomes available and is accurate as of the date of this posting. FASHIONPHILE reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

title: Acquisition Program Manager
description:
Description:

Quantum Sky is searching for an **Acquisition Program Manager** to support Mission Delta 3's 3rd Sustainment Training Squadron (3 STS). The 3 STS is responsible for providing product support, life\-cycle sustainment, and operational maintenance management for the Space Force’s mobile and fixed electromagnetic electronic warfare weapon systems **Responsibilities:*** Serves primarily as an Executive Assistant to the 3 STS Commander and provides advice, expertise and consultation in acquisition program management (PM) lifecycle activities, in concert with sustainment engineering, logistics and test and evaluation members to the government/squadron integrated planning team
* CORE EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Calendar \& Schedule Management: Coordinates the Commander's daily itinerary, balances competing priorities, and schedules high\-level meetings across Mission Delta 3 leadership.
* Travel Coordination (DTS): Authorizes and manages complex official travel profiles via the Defense Travel System (DTS), ensuring prompt voucher processing and compliance with Joint Travel Regulations.
* Correspondence Control: Reviews, formats, and routes official taskings, awards, performance evaluations, and memorandums to meet strict military writing standards.
* Meeting \& Event Logistics: Arranges conference spaces, prepares agendas, coordinates briefings, takes minutes, and tracks action items for commander\-led staff meetings.
* Visitor Protocol Support: Manages base access requests, coordinates building security entry, and assists with distinguished visitor (DV) protocol for incoming military and civilian leaders.
* Information Flow Management: Serves as the primary gatekeeper for the Commander, filtering incoming emails, phone calls, and actionable requests to ensure timely responses.
* Office Operations Management: Tracks squadron office supply budgets, coordinates facilities maintenance requests, and maintains digital and physical records management systems.
* Tasking \& Suspense Tracking: Monitor incoming directives from higher headquarters and ensure squadron staff submit their inputs before the suspense deadline hits.
* Document Quality Control: Review all official military letters, evaluation reports, and award packages for perfect formatting and grammar before the commander signs them.
* Meeting Logistics: Set up conference rooms, distribute slide decks, record action items, and ensure meetings start and end exactly on time.
* Distinguished Visitor Protocol: Coordinate base access, parking, and building entry for visiting senior leaders or corporate defense contractors.
* Information Screening: Filter massive volumes of daily emails and phone calls, ensuring the commander only sees issues requiring their direct attention.
* CORE ACQUISITION PROGRAM MANAGER RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Lifecycle Strategy Execution: Leads the execution of program baselines, acquisition strategies, and system modifications for fielded electromagnetic warfare assets like Counter Communications System (CCS) or Meadowlands.
* Cost, Schedule, \& Performance Tracking: Monitors contractor progress against strict cost estimates, milestone schedules, and technical performance metrics using Earned Value Management (EVM) data.
* Risk Management: Identifies, assesses, and mitigates technical, supply chain, and financial risks that could delay critical system upgrades or cause budget overruns.
* Budget Execution \& Planning: Manages program funding, monitors current year financial execution, and builds future budget requirements for the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) cycle.
* Contractual Oversight: Collaborates with contracting officers to draft Statements of Work (SOW), Requests for Proposal (RFP), and evaluates incoming defense contractor bids.
* Stakeholder Synchronization: Bridges communication gaps between operational space crews, higher Space Systems Command (SSC) leadership, and civilian contractor engineering teams.
* Rapid Acquisition Pathways: Utilizes Middle Tier of Acquisition (MTA) pathways to bypass traditional military bureaucracy and rapidly field urgent electronic warfare capabilities.
* Milestone Reviews: Prepares and briefs readiness documentation for high\-level program reviews, design reviews, and operational test readiness reviews.
* Experience working on classified government systems and networks


Qualifications:
**Required:*** Bachelor’s degree
* At least 17 years experience in Program Management and/or Executive Assistant (Government PM time preferred) but preferably 20 or more years of DoD and related Space operations combined experience, specifically acquisition program management, executive assitance and/or operational experience
* In lieu of a Bachelor’s degree and 17 years of relevant experience, a Master’s plus 8 years of related experience or PhD plus 4 years of related experience is acceptable.
* Experience with Air Force and/or Space Force operations, command and control (C2\), theater operations, space tasking cycle, and operator training, preferably with experience in the Electronic Warfare and/or Satellite Communications (SATCOM) mission areas.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Demonstrated competency in technical writing
* Familiarity operating under agile conditions as a member of a Scrum team
* Superior written and oral communication skills, including interpersonal and negotiation skills
* Familiar with MS Office products
* Experience in working with multi\-disciplinary teams of Military and technical managers

**Desired:*** Master’s degree (STEM)
* 20\+ years’ experience in Program Management and/or Executive Assistance (Government PM time preferred) of DoD and related Space operations combined experience, specifically acquisition program management and/or operational experience development of requirements, specifications and proposals; familiar with a variety of acquisition concepts, phases, and procedures.
* Scaled Agile Framework for Enterprises (SAFe), Project Management Institute\- Agile Certified Professional (PMI\- ACP), Certified Scrum Master, PMP, USAF Acquisition Professional Development Program (APDP) or similar certification
* Experience in the Electronic Warfare and/or Satellite Communications (SATCOM) mission areas or other USSF mission domains.
* Experience participating in technical studies and project performance reviews; ability to function in a multi\-contractor/customer environment
* Ability to perform a variety of complicated tasks, a wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected; demonstrated leadership and interpersonal skills; and effective written and oral communication skills required
* Familiarity working with or at the Combined Space Operations Center (CSpOC), US Space Command (USSPACECOM), and/or Space Force Field Commands
* Experience/knowledge navigating the Air Force’s cloud\-based DevSecOps Platform One enterprise service
* Experience/familiarity working as a Product Repository technician or lead.
* A successful candidate will coordinate the delivery of services among different program activities to increase effectiveness and efficiency leadership – proven success in leading high\-performance teams in an integrated product development team environment, achieving results through others, and being a strong team player
* Objectivity – Must maintain objectivity to determine proper standards, processes, and procedures that benefits the entire organization
* Creativity – Develop innovative solutions to modernize and improve system proficiencies (i.e. processes, procedures, techniques, tools, etc.)
* Flexibility – Receptive to change/new information and rapidly adapts to new technology, information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles
* Analytical Thinking \- Exceptional ability to analyze data and utilize it to make sound business decisions
* Conflict management and resolution skills
* Passionate \- Possess a passion for researching, defining and enforcing standards, processes and procedures
* Results focused – Ability to organize and manage multiple, and at time competing priorities
* Communication Skills – Demonstrate communication skills necessary to interpret policies in situations requiring persuasion and prepare and present presentations
* Relationship building skills – Ability to work within a dynamic team setting and provide role\-model leadership
* Customer service – Superior customer service skills to both internal and external customers

**Clearance:*** Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility required


About Tyto Athene:
**Compensation:*** Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically between $130,000\-$180,000\. This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above\-stated range.

**Benefits:*** Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Time Off, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and parental leave.

  

The world the mission operates in is going post\-quantum, contested, and machine\-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it.  

At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission\-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join \#TeamQuantumSky?  

Quantum Sky Engineering LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, \[sexual orientation, gender identity,] national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any characteristic protected by applicable law.
